title: Quick Start
description: Add the first Lomi UI checkout component to your app.

# Quick Start

Install a component with the shadcn CLI:

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://docs.lomi.africa/r/mobile-money-checkout-card.json
```

Then render it with plain props:

```tsx
import { MobileMoneyCheckoutCard } from '@/components/lomi-ui/mobile-money-checkout-card';

export function Checkout() {
  return (
    <MobileMoneyCheckoutCard
      selectedProvider="WAVE"
      fullName="Aya Konan"
      email="aya@example.com"
      phoneNumber="+2250700000000"
      payButtonBgColor="#121317"
      onSubmit={() => console.log('Create a Lomi checkout session')}
    />
  );
}
```

The components do not call the Lomi API directly. Use your backend or SDK integration to create checkout sessions, charge requests, and webhook handling.

## Asset paths

Copy hosted checkout assets into your app public folder:

- `/payment_channels/wave.webp`
- `/payment_channels/mtn.webp`
- `/payment_channels/pi_spi.webp`
- `/placeholder/card.webp`
- `/placeholder/bnpl.webp`

## Dependencies

Customer form components require:

```bash
npm install react-phone-number-input lucide-react
```
